metadata.scope: Ten targeted core source reviews including Jan 1–12 and May 27/29
metadata.method: Trace the occurrence/date/location to agency or original institutional records. Separate NOAA-derived survey retellings from independent institutions. Preserve NCEI IDs, historical title/place, never approve captions or media use automatically.

reviews.title_before: Heavy Snow — ALBUQUERQUE METRO AREA, New Mexico
reviews.title_after: New Year's winter storm blankets the Albuquerque metro
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: A major winter storm was departing New Mexico at the start of January 2019; NCEI catalogs a January 1 heavy-snow segment in the Albuquerque metro.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: NWS January climate review confirms statewide storm timing but does not independently remeasure each metro snowfall report, damaged-school count or regional impacts. Separate snowfall dates from the storm's exit date.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original dated Albuquerque-area snowfall and temperature observation map; reconcile daily station time windows

reviews.title_after: Straight-line winds strike Rehobeth during the January 2017 outbreak
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: NWS Tallahassee confirms January 2, 2017 damaging straight-line winds in the Rehobeth area, including the separate wind damage south of a nearby tornado.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: Four deaths in a mobile home were attributed to a tree in the straight-line-wind damage area; do not call this damage tornado-caused. NCEI Merritts Crossroads is a reporting location, not a separate named tornado.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Separate tornado survey tracks from south-flank straight-line-wind damage using the NWS survey
reviews.story_display_location: Rehobeth and Merritts Crossroads, Houston County, Alabama

reviews.title_after: A January F1 tornado races from Lydia toward New Iberia
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: NWS Lake Charles places an F1 tornado near Lydia and New Iberia on January 4, 2007, consistent with the NCEI Lydia segment.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: Use the original F1 Fujita rating, NOT EF1; 110-mph wind is a damage-survey estimate, not a direct measurement. Recheck tornado path/impact counts before any caption.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original Lydia-to-New-Iberia path map with 2007 Fujita rating and source-dated time markers

reviews.title_before: Wildfire — EST SAN GABRIEL MOUNTAINS, California
reviews.title_after: The Eaton Fire ignites amid extreme Southern California fire weather
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: CAL FIRE documents the Eaton Fire starting January 7, 2025 at 6:18 p.m. near Altadena Drive and Midwick Drive, Altadena/Pasadena; the NCEI record is for the Eaton Fire.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: Do not substitute the Palisades Fire, another January 7 event. NCEI wind gusts and PDS Red Flag context need separate weather-record review. CAL FIRE acreage is final multi-day footprint, not first-day burn area.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original timed fire-weather setup (surface wind, RH and warning area) next to a clearly dated Eaton Fire perimeter
reviews.story_display_location: Altadena–Pasadena and San Gabriel foothills, California

reviews.title_after: Exceptional rain and snowmelt flood Rochester and northern Indiana
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: NWS Northern Indiana documents heavy January 7–9, 2008 rain over Fulton County and ensuing flash/river flooding; Rochester's multiday accumulation appears in its station list, while NCEI places flooding on January 8.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: The Rochester rain total is for Jan 7–9, not a Jan 8-only observation. Do not assert all roads were closed or identify a specific flood crest without separately checking local records.
reviews.original_visual_concept: New January 7–9 observed-rainfall map over antecedent snowpack and January 8 roadway-flood reporting
reviews.story_display_location: Rochester and Fulton County, northern Indiana

reviews.title_after: Smoke and fog trigger the Interstate 4 super-fog pileup in Florida
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: NWS Tampa Bay identifies January 9, 2008 dense smoke-fog ('super fog') on Interstate 4 in Polk County, matching the NCEI event narrative.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: Do not treat smoke, radiation fog, and their combined super-fog visibility as synonymous; verify collision and casualty counts against original state highway/police reporting. Avoid using news photos without asset-level permission.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original roadway location / smoke-source and visibility-formation schematic with date-accurate weather observations

reviews.title_after: Settlement Road EF2 tornado crosses Pickens County, Alabama
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: NWS Birmingham documents the January 11, 2020 Settlement Road EF2 tornado in Pickens County, consistent with NCEI's Union Chapel reporting segment.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: EF2 maximum 134-mph wind is survey-inferred, not an anemometer reading. Review event-by-event path and deaths instead of conflating all Alabama tornadoes on January 11.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original Pickens County surveyed EF2 track plotted against settlement-area communities
reviews.story_display_location: Settlement Road and Union Chapel area, Pickens County, Alabama

reviews.title_before: Winter Storm — GREATER  PORTLAND METRO AREA, Oregon
reviews.title_after: Portland's January 2024 snow, ice and wind emergency begins
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: The City of Portland states that the metropolitan area's severe snow, ice and wind event began January 12, 2024 and continued through January 17; NCEI has a January 12 winter-storm segment.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: January 12 marks the event start, not necessarily its worst snowfall/ice or final outage toll. Municipal resolution corroborates chronology and impacts, not each NCEI wind or precipitation measurement.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original Portland multiday timeline showing snowfall, freezing rain, high wind and emergency-response milestones

reviews.title_after: The Jarrell F5 tornado devastates Double Creek Estates
reviews.corroborating_publisher: CDC Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: CDC's post-event mortality/injury investigation documents the May 27, 1997 Jarrell F5 tornado and impacts at Double Creek Estates; the NCEI Jarrell record belongs to that disaster.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: F5 is the pre-2007 Fujita rating, NOT EF5. Distinguish Jarrell from other May 27 tornadoes and possible predecessor vortices. CDC's 29 deaths span three tornadoes, not solely Jarrell, and historical estimates vary.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original survey-based Jarrell path and Double Creek corridor, distinctly showing separate storm reports
reviews.story_display_location: Jarrell and Double Creek Estates, Williamson County, Texas

reviews.title_after: The 1995 Great Barrington F4 tornado crosses the Berkshires
reviews.corroborated_core_claim: NWS Albany confirms a May 29, 1995 F4 tornado from near North Egremont across Great Barrington and toward Sandisfield, matching the NCEI North Egremont report.
reviews.unverified_claims_and_cautions: Use F4, not EF4. NCEI snippet gives 1906 EST but retrospective NWS page lists 7:06 p.m. EDT; reconcile local time convention before publishing any exact timestamp. A mapped impact polygon is estimated, not instrument-surveyed to the meter.
reviews.original_visual_concept: Original Berkshire County path map with separate documented versus estimated geometry and correct pre-2007 F rating
